evidence: EXPLORATORY_REUSED_HISTORY; previous evaluation results were already observed
hypothesis: Shallow nonlinear corrections around market probabilities, with invariant match context, may capture interactions missed by linear residuals. Compare all-history versus 3-year recency half-life, and full versus half correction. No post-result subgroup search.

features.base: Frozen enriched design from three_sport_residual; fixed zero for nonfinite inputs
features.atp_context_pre_run_audit: Before any new tuning/model returns, found inherited is_indoor and round_progress constant due to unrecognised Tennis-Data labels. Reconstruct these two columns by exact unique match_id from frozen matched master, using only indoor and round; preserve upstream files and report numbers of changed rows. Fixed ordinal mapping 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/QF/SF/F=1/2/3/4/5/6/7, RR=4, divided by7; unknown labels abort.
features.swap: Binary enriched descriptors change sign; context descriptors remain invariant. Train both orientations with half weight each; symmetrise predictions. Football retains home/draw/away order.

offset: Market logit for binary (target outcome zero), log probabilities for three classes, supplied in training AND prediction; no random validation or early stopping
recency: Weights exponential in age relative to fold cutoff, normalised to mean one before binary augmentation; half-life fixed to three years, not selected continuously
fit: Annual Jan1 fit on completed rows strictly before Jan1 minus7days. Fixed hyperparameters; current-year results can update next-year fit, never the frozen model family or threshold.
choice: Highest 95pct bootstrap lower ROI on tuning, among pairs with >=50settled; ties use declared candidate then threshold order; no eligible pair means abstention, not a lowered threshold
tuning_admission: Chosen tuning ROI2pct and ordinary95pct lower both positive; if rejected, evaluation remains a rejected diagnostic
secondary_staking: quarter_kelly diagnostic only, not selected on evaluation

uncertainty.scope: 192 previous nominal configurations plus72 new (3sports*4variants*3thresholds*2stakes), not all adaptive project research; circular3month blocks

research_gate: Tuning admission, >=200 settled evaluation, positive ROI at2and5pct, positive corrected lower, >=2positive years, positive without best profit year
limitations: Quote timing, availability and settlement in France unverified
Inherits documented ATP source conflicts and retrospective stat revisions
No new injury, true xG or point-in-time archive collected
No claim that nonlinear models or staking ensure profit
